en.headline: CHP investigates imported mpox case as yearly total hits 27
en.dek: A 29-year-old man is in stable isolation after testing positive, with 18 of this year's cases recorded since August.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Monday it is investigating an imported mpox case involving a 29-year-old man who is in stable condition in isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital.

The man developed a fever and sore throat on 13 September and a rash on his face, trunk, limbs and genital area from 17 September. He attended a Department of Health social hygiene clinic on 21 September and was later admitted. Laboratory testing by the Centre's Public Health Laboratory Services Branch confirmed the monkeypox virus.

The patient told investigators he had high-risk contact with a male stranger while outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. The Centre said it had so far found no epidemiological link between this case and earlier confirmed cases in the city.

Hong Kong has recorded 27 mpox cases this year, including 21 local and six imported, of which 18 were reported from August onwards. All patients this year have been male. The Centre again urged people who have had high-risk sexual contact, particularly with strangers, to take precautions, including vaccination, and to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having mpox.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查一宗輸入猴痘個案 本年累計27宗
zh.dek: 一名29歲男子化驗呈陽性，現於瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，情況穩定；本年18宗個案自8月起錄得。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周一表示，正調查一宗輸入猴痘確診個案，病人為一名29歲男子，現於瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
該名男子於9月13日起出現發燙及喉囉痛，9月17日起在面部、軆幹、四肢及生殖器官位置出現皮疹。他於9月21日到衞生署社會衞生科診所求診，其後入院。中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗其臨床樣本，證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據病人提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾離港，並與一名陌生男子有高風險接觸。中心表示，暫時未發現此個案與本港早前錄得的猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連。
本年本港累計錄得27宗猴痘個案，包括21宗本地及6宗輸入，當中18宗自8月起呈報，全部病人均為男性。中心再次呼籲曾有高風險性接觸的人士，尤其與陌生人接觸者，提高警覺並採取防護措施，包括接種猴痘疫苗，切勿與懷疑感染者作密切身體接觸。
